items.rationale: The initial assessment is covered under 5.2.6(b); the €524 case-20 benchmark is below the separate €3,000 assessment cap. The €500 deductible applies once to the event, not separately to this line.
Indoor pinpointing is covered under 5.2.6(a), with no technician time expressly included in this line. The €520 estimate plus €150 for line 3 is below the shared €1,000 leak-location cap.
Section 5.2.6(a) covers on-site technician time; 2.5 hours at €60 gross gives €150. Nothing states that this time is already included in line 2, and both lines together remain below the shared cap.
Section 5.2.6(c) allows one vehicle charge on the leak detector's invoice, even though the invoice uses an hourly unit. The €79 benchmark is below the €83.30 gross cap at 19% VAT.

items.description: Repair of two actively leaking copper joints
items.rationale: Section 2.4.3 treats age-related leakage as fracture damage for the sections shown to be leaking; age alone does not establish a maintenance breach under 9.1.1. The €340 estimate covers local labour and standard fittings for two joint repairs, not renewal of the run.

items.description: Precautionary replacement of non-leaking copper run
items.rationale: Sections 2.4.3 and 7.1.5 exclude sections not shown to be leaking and replaced only as a precaution. The positive figure is a conditional estimate for standard-grade renewal of this line, not an allowance.
Section 7.1.9 excludes the separately billed upgrade difference, and 2.4.3 independently excludes renewal of non-leaking sections. The positive figure is a conditional estimate of the surcharge only.
Section 5.2.6(c) permits one vehicle charge on the plumber's separate invoice for the trip needed to repair the leaking joints. The €79 benchmark is below the €83.30 gross cap at 19% VAT.
